HERITAGE OF
EXCELLENCE
Founded in 2006 by visionary perfumer Mr. Abdullah Karji, First
Perfumes Ind LLC has established itself as a leading name in the
UAE’s perfume and cosmetics manufacturing sector. In less than two
decades, we have grown from a dedicated production facility into a
globally recognized manufacturing unit, celebrated for precision,
innovation, and craftsmanship. Our long-standing history has enabled
us to build deep industry expertise, positioning us as a trusted
partner for brands, retailers, and entrepreneurs worldwide. Whether
it’s creating heritage-inspired fragrances or cutting-edge modern
formulations, we have always remained committed to excellence in
manufacturing and innovation.

OUR Located in Jebel Ali, Dubai, our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility is designed
to meet the highest global standards of production and compliance. Spread
FACILITY across a dedicated industrial zone, the factory integrates all key manufacturing
functions under one roof, ensuring full control, efficiency, and traceability.

UAE’s fragrance and cosmetics manufacturing industry. With a balance of
heritage, innovation, and sustainability, we continue to deliver excellence
for partners who trust us with their brands.
